selected.title: Non-blocking retries in TableView
selected.summary: Replaced sleeps on the callback thread with scheduled retries. Also checked how pending retries could retain a closed view.

paragraphs.text: A reviewer pointed out the sleep on the callback thread. I also found that repeated failures could grow the call stack, then moved retries to a scheduler.

Cancelling the future did not release the closed view. I checked this with a weak reference. Later review measurements also led me to undo a change that delayed later reads after a message had already been consumed.

selected.title: Message-mapped TableView (PIP-445)
selected.summary: Worked on the proposal and implementation so callers can build TableView values from message properties and metadata, rather than just the payload.

paragraphs.text: I wrote the initial implementation in response to a user request, revised the proposal, and ran the vote. I also handled message pooling for mapped views.
lhotari proposed the mapper approach and contributed the final error-handling interface, constraints, and implementation changes.

selected.title: Encryption key loading and producer cleanup
selected.summary: Closed producers after key-loading failures and made creation wait for the first successful key load, covering both cleanup and asynchronous readiness.

paragraphs.text: The connection and key load run independently. A slow key reader could let create() succeed before a key was available. A separate failure path completed the creation future but left the producer registered.

The fixes close failed producers and wait for the first key load before reporting successful creation. Regression coverage includes delayed key readers, cleanup, close, and reconnect while key loading is pending.

selected.title: Ordering ACK and FLOW after reconnect
selected.summary: Moved the pending ACK flush before FLOW on the same connection, preventing already-acknowledged messages from being redelivered during reconnect.

paragraphs.text: FLOW let the broker resume delivery before it received the queued acknowledgements. Flushing those acknowledgements also cleared the client's pending-ACK state, so its duplicate check could no longer recognize the redelivered messages.
Sending ACKs first on the same connection makes the broker process them before it resumes delivery, avoiding that reconnect race.

selected.title: Reading an uploaded file more than once
selected.summary: Small uploads shared a buffer's read position, so a second read returned nothing. Fixed repeated reads and copies to behave the same for files stored in memory and on disk.

paragraphs.text: The tests vary the size threshold to store the same file in memory and on disk. They read it twice, then copy it to another file and check that the content is still intact.

selected.title: Build progress in Windows Terminal
selected.summary: Enabled taskbar build progress in Windows Terminal, including WSL. Checked terminal detection and the emitted control sequences across WSL, PowerShell, and cmd.

entries.title: Re-run the migration check until ClusterMigrationTest producers can migrate
entries.caption: Repeats the migration check until replication backlog drains, matching the broker's periodic behavior instead of relying on a single check.

entries.title: Wait for replication markers in the deduplication test
entries.caption: Waiting for a new snapshot id raced the 100 ms snapshot timer; the test now waits for the replication marker entry written after each message.

entries.title: Export the Prometheus Java client 1.x registry from the Functions worker /metrics
entries.caption: The standalone worker writes the 1.x default registry after its existing simpleclient output, so cache metrics stay visible as collectors move to the new client.

entries.title: Expose the Prometheus Java client 1.x registry in broker and proxy metrics
entries.caption: Broker and proxy /metrics now write both registries; a byte-stream filter adds the cluster label to 1.x output, and in-process bookies get a separate registry.

entries.title: Wait for the first encryption key load before completing producer creation
entries.caption: With a slow key reader, the connection finished first and create() returned a producer with no key; creation now also waits for the first key load.

entries.title: Flush pending acks before the flow command when a consumer reconnects
entries.caption: Sending permits first let the broker redeliver messages whose acks were still queued; flushing acks first on the same connection avoids handing duplicates to applications.

entries.title: Stop the partition update timer when a partitioned producer fails during creation
entries.caption: A producer that closed inside its constructor still scheduled a timer whose finally block kept rescheduling it; the timer now stops once the producer has closed or failed.

entries.title: Stub the cancellable listener in PulsarLedgerCreateRecoveryTest
entries.caption: Returns a non-null cancellation handle from the mocked metadata store, preventing cleanup from failing after the listener API changed.

entries.title: Close the producer when its encryption key cannot be loaded
entries.caption: A failed key load failed create() but left the producer connecting and registered on the broker, so retries piled up producers; it is now closed and removed.

entries.title: Document in CODING.md that a delayedExecutor() task cannot be taken back
entries.caption: Cancelling a future built on delayedExecutor() only skips the run; the queued task keeps its captured objects reachable until the delay ends, as a weak-reference check showed.

entries.title: Complete a TableView refresh that waits for a message that could not be applied
entries.caption: When applying a message threw, its position was never recorded, so a refresh waiting for it hung on quiet topics; the position is now recorded before rethrowing.

entries.title: Complete a v5 send in place while its client is closing
entries.caption: A send failure queued on the completion executor could be dropped by shutdownNow(), leaving the future pending; while the client closes, it is completed on the current thread.

entries.title: Wait for the ack to be persisted before rewinding in V5StreamConsumerAckWatermarkTest
entries.caption: The in-process cursor reset could overtake the ack still on the wire, so the test now waits until the ack is applied and persisted before rewinding.

entries.title: Schedule TableView tail-read retries instead of sleeping on the callback thread
entries.caption: A reviewer's note exposed a 50 ms sleep on the client callback thread; retries now use backoff on a delayed executor, and closing the view fails pending refreshes.

entries.title: PIP-445: Propose message-mapped TableView builders
entries.caption: Proposal to add createMapped to TableViewBuilder, using the mapper-function design a maintainer suggested, so users can keep message metadata without extra cost for existing views.

entries.title: PIP-445: Implement message-mapped TableView builders
entries.caption: Moved TableView logic into a shared generic base class for mapped views; a maintainer's final pass added the mapper error model that skips failing messages and reports them.

entries.title: Require a semicolon before MIME type parameters
entries.caption: The 7.1 MIME type parser accepted whitespace alone as a parameter separator; this makes it reject such values again, following RFC 9110 and the 7.0.x behavior.

entries.title: Avoid leaking a temp file when the disk limit is exceeded in PartGenerator
entries.caption: Checks the per-part disk limit before creating a temporary file, so oversized buffered content does not leave an orphan file behind.

entries.title: Fix the fully populated check in DataClassRowMapper for classes with setters
entries.caption: Constructor parameters were removed from the mapped properties but not from the property name set, so checkFullyPopulated always failed for classes with setters.

entries.title: Make in-memory multipart Part content repeatable
entries.caption: In-memory parts shared one buffer read position, so a second content() or transferTo() call got empty data; each call now reads the bytes from the start.

entries.title: Avoid overflow for the default maxDelay with timeUnit in @Retryable
entries.caption: Uses saturating TimeUnit.toMillis conversion for millisecond and larger units, avoiding overflow while preserving finer Duration precision.
